flags: Requested cos(theta*) endpoints -1 and +1 are not evaluable in EXCLURAD and were clamped to -0.999 and +0.999 using the validated convention.
Beam energy defaulted to 6.53 GeV (validated eta campaign default); radiative corrections depend on beam energy.
explanation: Generated an eta-channel EXCLURAD input scan at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg over five cos(theta*) values. The exact pole points cos(theta*)=+/-1 are physically requested but numerically unsupported by EXCLURAD, so they were adjusted to +/-0.999 before generation. The resulting five-point scan is: -0.999, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.999.
